comment: There is no MODE switch on the panel: AdMini.cpp:592-600 puts the two modes on the menu, printed 'Function (red)' and 'Loop (yellow)' after the light colour that shows them. There is no sustain or release stage here, so the menu offers only those two. The census output order is Envelope first and Signal second, which is the reverse of their order down the panel.
